critical_errors_to_avoid.directive: viewBox ALWAYS starts at origin: viewBox="0 0 WIDTH HEIGHT". NEVER copy width/height into first two positions. Example: For 1000×1400 canvas, use viewBox="0 0 1000 1400" NOT "1000 1400 1000 1400".
critical_errors_to_avoid.check: First two numbers in viewBox must be 0 0

critical_errors_to_avoid.directive: SVG attributes accept ONLY numeric literals. Compute all math in your head FIRST, then write the number. WRONG: font-size="0.10*1400". CORRECT: font-size="140". If asked for 10% of 1400, calculate 1400 × 0.10 = 140, then write 140.
critical_errors_to_avoid.check: Every attribute value must be a plain number, no *, /, +, - symbols

critical_errors_to_avoid.directive: To fill entire canvas, image width/height MUST EXACTLY MATCH canvas dimensions. If canvas is 1000×1400, then <image width="1000" height="1400">. NOT 1000×700. NOT 800×1400. Exact match required.
critical_errors_to_avoid.check: image width = canvas width AND image height = canvas height

critical_errors_to_avoid.directive: Centered text requires text-anchor="middle". Without this attribute, x position is treated as LEFT edge. To center text at x=500, you MUST write: <text x="500" text-anchor="middle">. If text-anchor is omitted, text will be left-aligned at x=500 (wrong).
critical_errors_to_avoid.check: All centered text elements must have text-anchor="middle"

critical_errors_to_avoid.directive: SVG draws in SOURCE ORDER (top to bottom). Element drawn FIRST appears BEHIND later elements. Correct order: 1) background image, 2) overlay/gradients, 3) text (so text appears ON TOP). WRONG order: overlay, then image (image will hide overlay).
critical_errors_to_avoid.check: Background elements first, foreground elements last

space_and_positioning.understanding_coordinates: In SVG, (0,0) is TOP-LEFT corner. X increases rightward. Y increases DOWNWARD. To place text 'near top', use small Y (e.g., 100-150). To place text 'near bottom', use Y close to canvas height minus margin (e.g., height - 70).
space_and_positioning.centering_horizontally: To center at horizontal midpoint: x = canvas_width / 2. For 1000px wide canvas, center is x=500.
space_and_positioning.centering_vertically: To center at vertical midpoint: y = canvas_height / 2. For 1400px tall canvas, center is y=700.
space_and_positioning.margin_rule: Keep text at least 50-100px from canvas edges for readability

preserveAspectRatio_behavior.xMidYMid_slice: Image fills entire canvas by CROPPING excess. If image aspect doesn't match canvas aspect, image will be clipped. This is CORRECT for full-page background photos.
preserveAspectRatio_behavior.xMidYMid_meet: Image fits INSIDE canvas without cropping, leaving empty space. Do NOT use for full-page backgrounds (will show gaps).
preserveAspectRatio_behavior.none: Image stretches/distorts to exactly fill canvas. Rarely appropriate.

execution_checklist: 1. Choose canvas dimensions (W×H) and write: <svg width="W" height="H" viewBox="0 0 W H">
2. Calculate all measurements: title size = H × 0.10, mid-page = H / 2, etc. Write numbers down.
3. Draw background image FIRST: <image href="..." x="0" y="0" width="W" height="H" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" />
4. Draw overlays/gradients SECOND (if needed): <rect width="W" height="H" fill="..." opacity="..." />
5. Draw text elements LAST: <text x="..." y="..." font-size="..." text-anchor="middle">...
7. Verify: viewBox starts with 0 0? No math expressions? Image dimensions match canvas? Text has text-anchor="middle"? Layering order correct?

common_small_model_traps.trap_1: Copying example syntax without adapting. If example shows viewBox="0 0 800 600", you must change numbers to YOUR canvas size, not copy verbatim.
common_small_model_traps.trap_2: Writing math as you think it. You must COMPUTE FIRST, then write the result. Your output cannot contain expressions like '1400*0.1' - only '140'.
common_small_model_traps.trap_3: Assuming text centers automatically. It does not. You must explicitly add text-anchor="middle" to EVERY centered text element.
common_small_model_traps.trap_4: Drawing in logical order (background after foreground) instead of visual order (background before foreground). SVG is not a layer system - it is sequential painting.
common_small_model_traps.trap_5: Partial image dimensions. If canvas is 1000×1400, image must be 1000×1400. Not 1000×700, not 1000×1000, exactly 1000×1400.

output_format.structure: Return ONLY the SVG markup. No markdown code fences, no explanations, no preamble. Start with <svg and end with </svg>.
output_format.validation: Before outputting, mentally verify each rule above. If any rule is violated, fix it.
